/** Services the iterative mode needs from the kernel (no single-pass planner). */
const ITERATIVE_REQUIRED_SERVICES = [
	...__vite_ssr_import_14__.CONTROL_SERVICES,
	"model",
	"tools",
	"telemetry"
];
const DEADLINE_EXCEEDED = Symbol("iterative-deadline-exceeded");
const AUDIT_GRACE_MS = 200;
const TERMINAL_STOPS = new Set([
	"COMPLETED",
	"HUMAN_TAKEOVER",
	"POLICY_DENIED",
	"INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
	"MAX_STEPS",
	"MAX_COST",
	"MAX_DURATION",
	"MAX_TOKENS",
	"MAX_MODEL_CALLS",
	"MAX_TOOL_CALLS",
	"MAX_REPLANS",
	"MAX_KNOWLEDGE_CALLS",
	"MAX_VERIFICATION_CALLS",
	"VERIFICATION_FAILED",
	"LOOP_DETECTED",
	"STATE_CONFLICT",
	"UNSAFE_REQUEST",
	"CANCELLED"
]);
function errorMessage(error) {
	return error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown failure";
};
function isNonEmptyString(value) {
	return typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0;
}
function bindCapabilityFingerprint(payload, capabilityFingerprint) {
	return capabilityFingerprint ? {
		capabilityFingerprint,
		input: payload
	} : payload;
};
function hasValidBoundaryInput(input) {
	const identityValues = [
		input.agent?.id,
		input.agent?.version,
		input.tenantId,
		input.conversationId,
		input.sessionId,
		input.correlationId,
		input.traceId
	];
	const budgetValues = [
		input.budget?.maxSteps,
		input.budget?.maxModelCalls,
		input.budget?.maxToolCalls,
		input.budget?.maxDurationMs,
		input.budget?.maxCostUsd,
		input.budget?.maxTokens
	];
	const optionalBudgetValues = [
		input.budget?.maxKnowledgeCalls,
		input.budget?.maxReplans,
		input.budget?.maxVerificationCalls,
		input.budget?.maxDecisionRepairs
	].filter((value) => value !== undefined);
	return identityValues.every(isNonEmptyString) && budgetValues.every((value) => typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0) && optionalBudgetValues.every((value) => Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0);
}
function describeTool(tool) {
	const { execute, ...descriptor } = tool;
	void execute;
	return descriptor;
}
function mapEvaluationToStopReason(evaluation) {
	if (evaluation.reasonCode === "HANDOFF_REQUIRED") return "HUMAN_TAKEOVER";
	if (evaluation.outcome === "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE") {
		return "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE";
	};
	if (evaluation.outcome === "NEEDS_USER") return "NEEDS_USER_INPUT";
	if (evaluation.outcome === "WAITING_APPROVAL") return "APPROVAL_REQUIRED";
	if (evaluation.outcome === "FAILED") return "VERIFICATION_FAILED";
	return "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE";
};
function boundedPayload(value, maxChars) {
	let serialized;
	try {
		serialized = JSON.stringify(value) ?? "";
	} catch {
		return "[unserializable payload]";
	};
	if (serialized.length <= maxChars) return value;
	return `${serialized.slice(0, maxChars)}…[truncated]`;
};
function defaultClaimValidation(claims, observations) {
	const evidence = new Set();
	for (const observation of observations) {
		if (observation.provenance.effectRef) {
			evidence.add(observation.provenance.effectRef);
		};
		if (observation.provenance.operationKey) {
			evidence.add(observation.provenance.operationKey);
		};
		const payload = observation.payload;
		if (payload && Array.isArray(payload.items)) {
			for (const item of payload.items) {
				/* v8 ignore next -- defensive: catalog items always carry a string itemId */
				if (typeof item?.itemId === "string") evidence.add(item.itemId);
			}
		}
	};
	const unsupported = claims.filter((claim) => claim.evidenceRefs.length === 0 || claim.evidenceRefs.some((ref) => !evidence.has(ref))).map((claim) => claim.text.slice(0, 240));
	return {
		valid: unsupported.length === 0,
		unsupportedClaims: unsupported
	};
}
/**
* Iterative governed runtime: the durable execution spine owns claiming,
* leases and transitions; this runtime owns the cognitive loop, step
* checkpoints, deterministic budgets and the completion evaluation. It never
* claims jobs, never persists SQL directly and never executes a tool after a
* rejected decision.
*/
class IterativeGovernedRuntime {
	options;
	runtimeVersion = __vite_ssr_import_1__.RUNTIME_V2_VERSION;
	orchestratorVersion;
	contextEngine;
	completionEvaluatorOverride;
	completionEvaluators = new Map();
	clock;
	repeatThreshold;
	maxSignatures;
	maxObservationPayloadChars;
	#kernel;
	#turns = new WeakMap();
	#responseRuns = new WeakMap();
	constructor(options) {
		this.options = options;
		if (options.toolResultContext && (options.toolResultContext.version !== 1 || options.maxObservationPayloadChars !== undefined || options.orchestrator.contextProtocol !== "complete-tool-v1" || typeof options.stepStore.compareAndSwapCheckpoint !== "function")) {
			throw new Error("complete-tool-v1 requires protocol1, atomic checkpoint CAS and no legacy payload truncation option.");
		};
		this.contextEngine = options.contextEngine ?? new __vite_ssr_import_5__.DefaultContextEngine();
		this.completionEvaluatorOverride = options.completionEvaluator;
		this.clock = options.clock ?? (() => new Date());
		this.repeatThreshold = Math.max(1, options.loopDetection?.repeatThreshold ?? 2);
		this.maxSignatures = options.loopDetection?.maxSignatures ?? 12;
		this.maxObservationPayloadChars = options.maxObservationPayloadChars ?? 4e3;
		this.orchestratorVersion = options.orchestratorVersion ?? __vite_ssr_import_1__.HYBRID_ORCHESTRATOR_VERSION;
	}
	/**
	* Dependency surface handed to the extracted dispatch domain. It is built
	* here, where private members are accessible, so the exported class keeps
	* its exact public contract and the module never touches instance state
	* directly.
	*/
	get dispatchContext() {
		return {
			options: this.options,
			maxObservationPayloadChars: this.maxObservationPayloadChars,
			stop: (stopReason, response) => this.stop(stopReason, response),
			operationKey: (run, stepNumber, toolId) => this.operationKey(run, stepNumber, toolId),
			remainingDuration: (run) => this.remainingDuration(run),
			makeObservation: (run, input) => this.makeObservation(run, input),
			checkAfterUsage: (run) => this.checkAfterUsage(run),
			allowedDecisionTypes: (run) => this.allowedDecisionTypes(run),
			evaluatorFor: (run) => this.evaluatorFor(run),
			validateClaims: (run, responseText) => this.validateClaims(run, responseText),
			withDeadline: (operation, remainingMs) => this.withDeadline(operation, remainingMs),
			recordObservation: (run, observation) => this.recordObservation(run, observation),
			recordStep: (run, input) => this.recordStep(run, input),
			persistCheckpoint: (run) => this.persistCheckpoint(run),
			preflightCompleteTool: (run, decision, stepNumber) => this.preflightCompleteTool(run, decision, stepNumber),
			safeAudit: (run, action, extras) => this.safeAudit(run, action, extras),
			composeResponse: (run, decision) => this.composeResponse(run, decision),
			kernel: (run) => this.kernelFor(run),
			turn: (run) => this.turnFor(run)
		};
	}
	/** Boots the kernel profile of the iterative mode once (SPEC 0181). */
	bootKernel() {
		this.#kernel ??= __vite_ssr_import_11__.KernelHost.boot([
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.budgetControl)(),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.pauseControl)(this.options.pause),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.logControl)(this.options.log),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.effectsControl)(this.options.effects),
			...this.options.sandbox ? [(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.sandboxControl)(this.options.sandbox)] : [],
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.policyControl)(this.options.policy),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.approvalsControl)(this.options.approvals, this.options.capabilityFingerprint ? { capabilityFingerprint: this.options.capabilityFingerprint } : {}),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.auditControl)(this.options.audit, { action: "harness.iterative" }),
			...this.options.toolResultContext ? [this.responseCheckpointControl()] : [],
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.modelCapability)(this.options.modelGateway),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.toolsCapability)(this.options.tools),
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_13__.telemetryCapability)(this.options.telemetry, { name: "harness.iterative" })
		], ITERATIVE_REQUIRED_SERVICES);
		return this.#kernel;
	}
	kernelFor(run) {
		const entry = this.#turns.get(run);
		/* v8 ignore next -- defensive: the loop only asks for its own bound run */
		if (!entry) throw new Error("Kernel turn is not bound to this run.");
		return entry.host;
	}
	responseCheckpointControl() {
		return {
			name: "control.iterative-response-checkpoint",
			kind: "control",
			apply: (ctx) => {
				ctx.on("model/before-call", async ({ turn, request }, next) => {
					if (request.purpose === "RESPONSE") {
						const run = this.#responseRuns.get(turn);
						if (!run) throw new Error("Response turn has no native run binding.");
						// beginModelRequest already owns and charged the native slot.
						// Only its committed checkpoint may precede model entry.
						await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
					};
					return next();
				});
			}
		};
	}
	/**
	* Kernel view of the current run: the iterative active-duration budget and
	* the caller's cancel signal drive the shared pipelines.
	*/
	turnFor(run) {
		const entry = this.#turns.get(run);
		/* v8 ignore next -- defensive: the loop only asks for its own bound run */
		if (!entry) throw new Error("Kernel turn is not bound to this run.");
		const turn = (0,__vite_ssr_import_12__.createTurnState)(run.input, run.startedAtMs, {
			remainingMs: () => this.remainingDuration(run),
			withDeadline: async (operation, ms = this.remainingDuration(run)) => {
				const outcome = await this.withDeadline(ms <= 0 ? new Promise(() => undefined) : operation(), ms);
				return outcome === DEADLINE_EXCEEDED ? __vite_ssr_import_14__.DEADLINE : outcome;
			},
			beginModelRequest: () => {
				// Single pre-model gate (PDSH-004 / I11): consume one slot.
				if (run.usage.modelCalls + 1 > run.input.budget.maxModelCalls) {
					return {
						kind: "stop",
						stopReason: "MAX_MODEL_CALLS",
						response: "Model-call budget exhausted before the call was started."
					};
				};
				this.accountUsage(run, {
					modelCalls: 1,
					inputTokens: 0,
					outputTokens: 0,
					costUsd: 0
				});
				return undefined;
			},
			recordModelResult: (result) => {
				// Single post-result accounting site (PDSH-004).
				this.accountUsage(run, {
					modelCalls: 0,
					inputTokens: result.inputTokens,
					outputTokens: result.outputTokens,
					costUsd: result.costUsd
				});
				if (run.usage.inputTokens + run.usage.outputTokens > run.input.budget.maxTokens) {
					return {
						kind: "stop",
						stopReason: "MAX_TOKENS",
						response: "Token budget exhausted before a response could be completed."
					};
				};
				if (run.usage.costUsd > run.input.budget.maxCostUsd) {
					return {
						kind: "stop",
						stopReason: "MAX_COST",
						response: "Cost budget exhausted before a response could be completed."
					};
				};
				return undefined;
			}
		}, entry.signal);
		if (this.options.toolResultContext) this.#responseRuns.set(turn, run);
		return turn;
	}
	async execute(input) {
		const startedAtMs = Date.now();
		const executionId = input.executionId ?? `execution_${input.correlationId}`;
		if (!hasValidBoundaryInput(input)) {
			return this.earlyFinish(input, "Runtime identity or execution budget is invalid.", "UNSAFE_REQUEST", startedAtMs);
		};
		if (this.options.capabilityFingerprint && input.capabilityFingerprint !== this.options.capabilityFingerprint) {
			return this.earlyFinish(input, "Capability composition fingerprint does not match the runtime.", "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
		};
		if (input.budget.maxSteps < 1) {
			return this.earlyFinish(input, "Execution budget exhausted before the first step.", "MAX_STEPS", startedAtMs);
		};
		if (input.budget.maxDurationMs < 1) {
			return this.earlyFinish(input, "Execution duration budget is not available.", "MAX_DURATION", startedAtMs);
		};
		let host;
		try {
			host = await this.bootKernel();
		} catch (error) {
			/* v8 ignore start -- defensive: the fixed plugin list always satisfies the boot contract */
			return this.earlyFinish(input, `Kernel could not start: ${errorMessage(error)}.`, "INTERNAL_FAILURE", startedAtMs);
		};
		let checkpoint = null;
		try {
			checkpoint = await this.options.stepStore.loadCheckpoint(input.tenantId, executionId);
		} catch (error) {
			return this.earlyFinish(input, `Execution checkpoint could not be trusted: ${errorMessage(error)}.`, "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
		};
		if (checkpoint) {
			if (this.options.toolResultContext && checkpoint.checkpointVersion === 1 && checkpoint.state.observations.some((value) => value.type === "TOOL_RESULT")) {
				return this.earlyFinish(input, "LEGACY_RESULT_UNKNOWN: old tool results cannot be promoted to complete.", "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", startedAtMs);
			};
			const rejection = this.rejectCheckpoint(checkpoint, input);
			if (rejection) {
				return this.earlyFinish(input, rejection, "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
			}
		};
		if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
			let steps;
			try {
				steps = await this.options.stepStore.listSteps(input.tenantId, executionId);
			} catch {
				return this.earlyFinish(input, "Native response attempt history is unavailable; reconciliation is required.", "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
			};
			if (steps.some((step) => step.tenantId === input.tenantId && step.executionId === executionId && step.stepType === "RESPOND" && step.stepNumber > (checkpoint?.state.stepNumber ?? 0))) {
				// A durable attempt ahead of the checkpoint is not permission to
				// replay it. Historical usage may be uncertain; preserve both facts.
				return this.earlyFinish(input, "Native response attempt is ahead of its checkpoint; usage is uncertain and reconciliation is required. No new model call was made.", "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
			};
			if ((checkpoint?.state.stopReason === "INTERNAL_FAILURE" || checkpoint?.state.stopReason === "MODEL_FAILURE") && steps.some((step) => step.tenantId === input.tenantId && step.executionId === executionId && step.stepType === "RESPOND" && step.stepNumber === checkpoint?.state.stepNumber)) {
				// A healthy final write can catch the cursor up after a transient
				// failure. That does not reopen the already stopped response attempt.
				return this.earlyFinish(input, "Complete response attempt already stopped; reconciliation is required and this checkpoint cannot resume. No new model call was made.", "STATE_CONFLICT", startedAtMs);
			}
		};
		const run = {
			checkpointToken: checkpoint ? {
				checkpointId: checkpoint.checkpointId,
				digest: checkpoint.digest
			} : null,
			input,
			executionId,
			startedAtMs,
			stepNumber: checkpoint?.state.stepNumber ?? 0,
			state: checkpoint ? {
				...checkpoint.state,
				observations: [...checkpoint.state.observations],
				openQuestions: [...checkpoint.state.openQuestions],
				resolvedInputs: { ...checkpoint.state.resolvedInputs },
				loopSignatures: [...checkpoint.state.loopSignatures]
			} : {
				goal: input.agent.objective,
				...this.options.capabilityFingerprint ? { capabilityFingerprint: this.options.capabilityFingerprint } : {},
				stepNumber: 0,
				observations: [],
				openQuestions: [],
				resolvedInputs: {},
				loopSignatures: []
			},
			usage: checkpoint ? { ...checkpoint.budgetUsage } : { ...__vite_ssr_import_1__.EMPTY_BUDGET_USAGE },
			observations: checkpoint ? [...checkpoint.state.observations] : [],
			responseText: null,
			lastDecision: null,
			lastEvaluation: null,
			lastToolObservation: null,
			lastSufficiency: null,
			lastDecisionErrors: [],
			skipEvaluationOnce: false,
			countedSteps: new Set(),
			inFlightCounted: Boolean(checkpoint?.state.pendingDecision && !checkpoint.state.stopReason)
		};
		run.state.observations = run.observations;
		if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
			run.state.toolResultContext ??= {
				version: 1,
				deliveredThroughStep: 0,
				pendingDecisionAdmission: null,
				decisionAdmissions: []
			};
		};
		const controller = new AbortController();
		if (input.signal?.aborted) controller.abort();
		input.signal?.addEventListener("abort", () => controller.abort(), { once: true });
		this.#turns.set(run, {
			host,
			signal: controller.signal
		});
		// Payloads and summaries are bounded, untrusted presentation. The step
		// store owns the lossless governed outcome of the pending dispatch,
		// including the exact settlement failure cause. Generic TOOL_FAILURE or
		// unknown_effect records alone do not prove that this ledger failed.
		if (checkpoint?.state.pendingStepNumber && (checkpoint.state.pendingDecision?.decisionType === "CALL_TOOL" || checkpoint.state.pendingDecision?.decisionType === "REQUEST_APPROVAL")) {
			let steps;
			try {
				steps = await this.options.stepStore.listSteps(input.tenantId, executionId);
			} catch {
				return this.finalize(run, {
					kind: "stop",
					stopReason: "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
					response: "Pending tool outcome could not be read; reconciliation is required.",
					preserveCheckpoint: true
				}, startedAtMs);
			};
			if (steps.some((step) => step.tenantId === input.tenantId && step.executionId === executionId && step.stepNumber === checkpoint.state.pendingStepNumber && step.stepType === "TOOL" && step.status === "FAILED" && step.errorCode === "unknown_effect: effect_settlement_failed")) {
				return this.finalize(run, {
					kind: "stop",
					stopReason: "TOOL_FAILURE",
					response: "unknown_effect: effect_settlement_failed",
					preserveCheckpoint: true
				}, startedAtMs);
			};
			if (this.options.toolResultContext && checkpoint.state.pendingStepNumber) {
				const pendingStep = checkpoint.state.pendingStepNumber;
				const settledStep = steps.find((step) => step.tenantId === input.tenantId && step.executionId === executionId && step.stepNumber === pendingStep && step.stepType === "TOOL" && step.status === "SUCCEEDED");
				const savedResult = checkpoint.state.observations.find((observation) => observation.type === "TOOL_RESULT" && observation.stepNumber === pendingStep);
				if (!settledStep && steps.some((step) => step.tenantId === input.tenantId && step.executionId === executionId && step.stepNumber === pendingStep && step.stepType === "TOOL" && (step.status === "RUNNING" || step.status === "FAILED"))) {
					let hasReservation = false;
					try {
						const pending = checkpoint.state.pendingDecision;
						const proof = await this.withDeadline((0,__vite_ssr_import_10__.hasNativeEffectReservation)(this.options.tools.resolve(pending.toolId, pending.toolVersion), input.tenantId, this.operationKey(run, pendingStep, pending.toolId)), this.remainingDuration(run));
						hasReservation = proof === true;
					} catch {};
					if (!hasReservation) {
						return this.finalize(run, {
							kind: "stop",
							stopReason: "TOOL_FAILURE",
							preserveCheckpoint: true,
							response: "unknown_effect: pending tool dispatch has no prior native journal reservation; explicit reconciliation is required."
						}, startedAtMs);
					}
				};
				if (settledStep && (!savedResult || savedResult.payload.completion !== "COMPLETE")) {
					return this.finalize(run, {
						kind: "stop",
						stopReason: "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE",
						preserveCheckpoint: true,
						response: "RESULT_UNAVAILABLE: a settled tool step has no complete saved result; reconciliation is required."
					}, startedAtMs);
				};
				if (settledStep && savedResult) {
					const pending = checkpoint.state.pendingDecision;
					if (savedResult.stepId !== settledStep.stepId || !settledStep.observationRefs.includes(savedResult.observationId) || savedResult.provenance.sourceId !== pending.toolId || savedResult.provenance.sourceVersion !== pending.toolVersion || savedResult.provenance.operationKey !== this.operationKey(run, pendingStep, pending.toolId)) {
						return this.finalize(run, {
							kind: "stop",
							stopReason: "STATE_CONFLICT",
							preserveCheckpoint: true,
							response: "Saved tool result does not match the settled native step."
						}, startedAtMs);
					};
					// The acknowledged result and successful step complete this dispatch.
					// Never reopen it or call its journal/tool again on process recreation.
					run.stepNumber = pendingStep;
					run.inFlightCounted = false;
					run.countedSteps.add(pendingStep);
					run.lastToolObservation = savedResult;
					run.state = {
						...run.state,
						stepNumber: pendingStep,
						pendingDecision: undefined,
						pendingStepNumber: undefined,
						pendingApprovalId: undefined,
						selectedCapability: pending.toolId,
						loopSignatures: [...run.state.loopSignatures, (0,__vite_ssr_import_7__.decisionSignature)(pending)].slice(-this.maxSignatures),
						toolResultContext: {
							...run.state.toolResultContext,
							acceptedDecision: undefined
						}
					};
				}
			}
		};
		const resumeOutcome = this.applyResume(run, checkpoint);
		if (resumeOutcome) {
			return this.finalize(run, resumeOutcome, startedAtMs);
		};
		run.lastDecision = run.state.pendingDecision ?? null;
		run.lastEvaluation = run.state.lastEvaluation ?? null;
		try {
			if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
				const state = run.state.toolResultContext;
				const orphaned = state.decisionAdmissions.filter((value) => value.status === "RESERVED" || value.status === "SETTLED" && value.stepNumber > run.state.stepNumber && !state.acceptedDecision && !run.state.pendingDecision);
				if (orphaned.length > 0 || state.decisionAdmissions.some((value) => value.status === "UNKNOWN")) {
					const ids = new Set(orphaned.filter((value) => value.status === "RESERVED").map((value) => value.admissionId));
					for (const record of orphaned) {
						if (record.status === "SETTLED" && record.actual) {
							run.usage.inputTokens += Math.max(record.reserved.inputTokens, record.actual.inputTokens) - record.actual.inputTokens;
							run.usage.outputTokens += Math.max(record.reserved.outputTokens, record.actual.outputTokens) - record.actual.outputTokens;
							run.usage.costUsd += Math.max(record.reserved.costUsd, record.actual.costUsd) - record.actual.costUsd;
						}
					};
					run.state.toolResultContext = {
						...state,
						pendingDecisionAdmission: null,
						decisionAdmissions: state.decisionAdmissions.map((value) => ids.has(value.admissionId) ? {
							...value,
							status: "UNKNOWN",
							unknownReason: "process_lost_before_decision"
						} : value)
					};
					// A settled receipt is immutable: a crash before acceptedDecision is
					// evidence of an unresolved decision, not permission to replay a model.
					// Keep the acknowledged checkpoint and return conservative live usage.
					return await this.finalize(run, {
						...this.stop("INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE", "DECISION_USAGE_UNKNOWN: unresolved decision needs handoff."),
						...orphaned.some((value) => value.status === "SETTLED") ? { preserveCheckpoint: true } : {}
					}, startedAtMs);
				};
				await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
			};
			await this.safeAudit(run, "runtime_v2.started", { result: checkpoint ? "resumed" : "started" });
			const outcome = await this.runLoop(run);
			return await this.finalize(run, outcome, startedAtMs);
		} catch (error) {
			return await this.finalize(run, {
				kind: "stop",
				stopReason: run.primaryResponseFailure && !run.checkpointConflict ? "MODEL_FAILURE" : error instanceof __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError ? error.stopReason : "INTERNAL_FAILURE",
				response: run.primaryResponseFailure ? `${run.primaryResponseFailure} Secondary response failure: ${errorMessage(error)}.` : error instanceof __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError ? `${error.code}: ${error.message}` : `Execution failed internally: ${errorMessage(error)}.`,
				...run.checkpointConflict ? { preserveCheckpoint: true } : {}
			}, startedAtMs);
		}
	}
	rejectCheckpoint(checkpoint, input) {
		if (checkpoint.checkpointVersion === 2 && !this.options.toolResultContext) {
			return "Complete checkpoint requires the explicitly configured complete-tool-v1 mode.";
		};
		if (checkpoint.runtimeProfile !== "iterative") {
			return "Execution checkpoint belongs to a different runtime profile.";
		};
		if (checkpoint.runtimeVersion !== __vite_ssr_import_1__.RUNTIME_V2_VERSION) {
			return `Execution checkpoint requires runtime ${checkpoint.runtimeVersion}, this runtime is ${__vite_ssr_import_1__.RUNTIME_V2_VERSION}.`;
		};
		if (this.options.toolResultContext && checkpoint.orchestratorVersion !== this.orchestratorVersion) {
			return "Execution checkpoint belongs to a different orchestrator version.";
		};
		if (input.runtimeProfile && input.runtimeProfile !== "iterative") {
			return "Execution checkpoint conflicts with the requested runtime profile.";
		};
		if (this.options.capabilityFingerprint && checkpoint.state.capabilityFingerprint !== this.options.capabilityFingerprint) {
			return "Execution checkpoint belongs to a different capability composition.";
		};
		if (checkpoint.state.stopReason && TERMINAL_STOPS.has(checkpoint.state.stopReason) && checkpoint.state.stopReason !== "NEEDS_USER_INPUT" && checkpoint.state.stopReason !== "APPROVAL_REQUIRED") {
			return "Terminal execution cannot be resumed.";
		};
		return null;
	}
	applyResume(run, checkpoint) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.applyResume)(this.dispatchContext, run, checkpoint);
	}
	async runLoop(run) {
		if (run.state.pendingQuestion) {
			// Deterministic rule: a pending question must not be answered by a new
			// model decision. Re-pause without spending a model call.
			return this.pause(run, Math.max(1, run.state.stepNumber), {
				kind: "pause",
				pausedKind: "NEEDS_USER_INPUT",
				decision: null
			});
		};
		while (true) {
			// I8: cancellation is honored before every step.
			if (this.#turns.get(run)?.signal.aborted) {
				return this.stop("CANCELLED", (0,__vite_ssr_import_12__.CANCELLED_RESPONSE));
			};
			// I12: pause (and any other step control) is checked before each step.
			const beforeStep = await (0,__vite_ssr_import_12__.runGate)(this.kernelFor(run), "turn/before-step", this.turnFor(run));
			if (beforeStep.kind === "stop") {
				// An operator pause is not terminal: the durable checkpoint, with any
				// pending approval or question, stays resumable (AUD-0597 F03).
				return {
					...this.stop(beforeStep.stopReason, beforeStep.response),
					/* v8 ignore next -- the pause control is the only before-step control */
					...beforeStep.cause === "operator_paused" ? { preserveCheckpoint: true } : {}
				};
			};
			const budgetStop = this.checkBudget(run);
			if (budgetStop) return this.stop(budgetStop.reason, budgetStop.response);
			let decision;
			let stepNumber;
			let decisionAdmissionIds;
			let modelDecision = false;
			if (run.state.pendingDecision && run.state.pendingStepNumber) {
				decision = run.state.pendingDecision;
				stepNumber = run.state.pendingStepNumber;
				run.lastDecision = decision;
			} else if (this.options.toolResultContext && run.state.toolResultContext?.acceptedDecision) {
				const accepted = run.state.toolResultContext.acceptedDecision;
				if (accepted.stepNumber !== run.stepNumber + 1) throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Accepted decision is bound to another step.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
				decision = accepted.decision;
				stepNumber = accepted.stepNumber;
				decisionAdmissionIds = accepted.decisionAdmissionIds;
				run.lastDecision = decision;
			} else {
				stepNumber = run.stepNumber + 1;
				if (stepNumber > run.input.budget.maxSteps) {
					return this.stop("MAX_STEPS", "Step budget exhausted.");
				};
				const decisionResult = await this.decide(run, stepNumber);
				if (decisionResult.outcome) return decisionResult.outcome;
				decision = (0,__vite_ssr_import_1__.sanitizeLoopDecision)(decisionResult.decision);
				decisionAdmissionIds = decisionResult.decisionAdmissionIds;
				modelDecision = decisionResult.modelDecision ?? false;
				run.lastDecision = decision;
			};
			const validation = this.validateDecision(run, decision);
			if (!validation.valid) {
				if (!this.options.toolResultContext) run.usage.decisionRepairs += 1;
				run.lastDecisionErrors = validation.errors;
				const repairBudget = run.input.budget.maxDecisionRepairs ?? 1;
				if ((this.options.toolResultContext ? run.usage.decisionRepairs + 1 : run.usage.decisionRepairs) <= repairBudget && !run.state.pendingDecision) {
					continue;
				};
				const capabilityOnly = validation.errors.every((error) => error.startsWith("capability:"));
				return this.stop(capabilityOnly ? "STATE_CONFLICT" : "MODEL_FAILURE", `Orchestrator decision was rejected: ${validation.errors.join("; ")}`);
			};
			run.lastDecisionErrors = [];
			if (this.options.toolResultContext && !run.state.pendingDecision) {
				const state = run.state.toolResultContext;
				run.state.toolResultContext = {
					...state,
					deliveredThroughStep: modelDecision ? Math.max(state.deliveredThroughStep, ...run.observations.filter((value) => value.type === "TOOL_RESULT").map((value) => value.stepNumber)) : state.deliveredThroughStep,
					acceptedDecision: {
						stepNumber,
						decision,
						decisionAdmissionIds: decisionAdmissionIds ?? []
					}
				};
				await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
			};
			const signature = (0,__vite_ssr_import_7__.decisionSignature)(decision);
			if (decision.decisionType !== "STOP") {
				const repeats = run.state.loopSignatures.filter((candidate) => candidate === signature).length;
				const threshold = this.effectiveRepeatThreshold(run, decision);
				const cycle = (0,__vite_ssr_import_7__.detectDecisionCycle)(run.state.loopSignatures, signature);
				if (repeats >= threshold || cycle) {
					await this.recordStep(run, {
						stepNumber,
						stepType: "POLICY",
						status: "FAILED",
						sideEffecting: false,
						errorCode: "loop_detected",
						reasonCode: "LOOP_SUSPECTED"
					});
					return this.stop("LOOP_DETECTED", cycle ? "A repeated decision cycle was detected; the loop stopped without executing another effect." : "Repeated identical decisions were detected; the loop stopped without executing another effect.");
				}
			};
			await this.safeAudit(run, "orchestrator.decided", {
				result: `${decision.decisionType}:${decision.reasonCode}`,
				tool: decision.toolId ?? null
			});
			const dispatch = await this.dispatch(run, decision, stepNumber);
			if (dispatch.kind === "pause") {
				return await this.pause(run, stepNumber, dispatch);
			};
			if (dispatch.kind === "stop") {
				run.stepNumber = stepNumber;
				if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
					run.state.stepNumber = stepNumber;
					run.state.toolResultContext = {
						...run.state.toolResultContext,
						acceptedDecision: undefined
					};
				};
				return dispatch;
			};
			const signatures = [...run.state.loopSignatures, signature].slice(-this.maxSignatures);
			run.stepNumber = stepNumber;
			run.state = {
				...run.state,
				stepNumber,
				loopSignatures: signatures,
				pendingDecision: undefined,
				pendingStepNumber: undefined,
				selectedCapability: decision.toolId ?? decision.selectedCapability ?? run.state.selectedCapability
			};
			if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
				run.state.toolResultContext = {
					...run.state.toolResultContext,
					acceptedDecision: undefined
				};
			};
			await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
			if (run.skipEvaluationOnce) {
				run.skipEvaluationOnce = false;
				continue;
			};
			const evaluationOutcome = await this.evaluate(run, decision);
			if (evaluationOutcome) return evaluationOutcome;
		}
	}
	checkBudget(run) {
		if (this.effectiveDuration(run) > run.input.budget.maxDurationMs) {
			return {
				reason: "MAX_DURATION",
				response: "Duration budget exhausted."
			};
		};
		// An in-flight step persisted before a pause/crash is allowed to settle
		// even when it consumed the last step slot.
		if (run.stepNumber >= run.input.budget.maxSteps && !run.state.pendingDecision) {
			return {
				reason: "MAX_STEPS",
				response: "Step budget exhausted."
			};
		};
		return null;
	}
	stop(stopReason, response) {
		return {
			kind: "stop",
			stopReason,
			response
		};
	}
	async buildStepContext(run, stepNumber) {
		const remaining = this.remainingDuration(run);
		if (remaining <= 0) {
			return { outcome: this.stop("MAX_DURATION", "Duration budget exhausted before the next decision.") };
		};
		const stateForContext = {
			...run.state,
			observations: run.resumeObservation && !run.observations.some((value) => value.observationId === run.resumeObservation.observationId) ? [...run.observations, run.resumeObservation] : run.observations
		};
		const buildInput = {
			runtime: {
				executionId: run.executionId,
				tenantId: run.input.tenantId,
				conversationId: run.input.conversationId,
				correlationId: run.input.correlationId,
				traceId: run.input.traceId,
				userMessage: this.options.toolResultContext && run.input.resume?.kind === "user_input" ? run.input.resume.message : run.input.userMessage,
				context: run.input.context,
				objective: run.input.agent.objective,
				instructions: run.input.agent.instructions,
				agentId: run.input.agent.id,
				agentVersion: run.input.agent.version
			},
			...this.options.toolResultContext ? { toolResultContext: this.options.toolResultContext } : {},
			profile: "iterative",
			stepNumber,
			goal: run.state.goal,
			state: stateForContext,
			capabilities: this.availableTools(run),
			knowledgeAvailable: Boolean(this.options.knowledge),
			completionStrategy: run.input.agent.completionStrategy ?? "DETERMINISTIC",
			allowedDecisionTypes: this.allowedDecisionTypes(run),
			budget: run.input.budget,
			budgetUsage: run.usage,
			...(this.options.toolResultContext ? run.lastDecisionErrors.length > 0 : run.usage.decisionRepairs > 0) ? { decisionRepair: {
				attempt: this.options.toolResultContext ? run.usage.decisionRepairs + 1 : run.usage.decisionRepairs,
				errors: run.lastDecisionErrors
			} } : {}
		};
		const complete = Boolean(this.options.toolResultContext);
		const nativeInput = complete ? structuredClone(buildInput) : buildInput;
		const building = this.contextEngine.build(complete ? structuredClone(nativeInput) : nativeInput);
		const built = complete ? await this.withDeadline(building, this.remainingDuration(run)) : await building;
		if (built === DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) {
			return { outcome: this.stop("MAX_DURATION", "Context assembly exceeded the execution deadline.") };
		};
		// A custom engine may retain and reuse its returned objects. Validate and
		// render the same detached value across the following async boundaries.
		const context = complete ? structuredClone(built) : built;
		if (complete) {
			const native = await new __vite_ssr_import_5__.DefaultContextEngine({ tokenBudget: context.tokenBudget }).build(nativeInput);
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.validateCompleteStepContext)(context, native);
			for (const observation of run.observations) {
				if (observation.type === "TOOL_RESULT") {
					(0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.assertCompleteToolObservation)(observation);
					if (observation.payload.completion === "UNAVAILABLE") {
						throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("RESULT_UNAVAILABLE", "A complete tool result is unavailable.");
					}
				}
			}
		};
		return { context };
	}
	async decide(run, stepNumber) {
		const remaining = this.remainingDuration(run);
		const assembled = await this.buildStepContext(run, stepNumber);
		if ("outcome" in assembled) return assembled;
		const { context } = assembled;
		const complete = Boolean(this.options.toolResultContext);
		const decisionAbortController = new AbortController();
		const parentSignal = this.#turns.get(run)?.signal;
		const abort = () => decisionAbortController.abort();
		if (parentSignal?.aborted) abort();
		parentSignal?.addEventListener("abort", abort, { once: true });
		const priorIds = new Set(run.state.toolResultContext?.decisionAdmissions.map((value) => value.admissionId));
		const admission = complete ? new __vite_ssr_import_3__.CompleteDecisionAdmission({
			run,
			stepNumber,
			tokenBudget: context.tokenBudget,
			signal: decisionAbortController.signal,
			remainingMs: () => this.remainingDuration(run),
			preflight: (state, usage) => this.preflightDecisionReceipt(run, state, usage),
			persist: () => this.persistCheckpoint(run),
			audit: (action, result) => this.safeAudit(run, action, { result })
		}) : undefined;
		let failed = false;
		try {
			const decisionOrDeadline = await this.withDeadline(this.options.orchestrator.decide({
				context,
				...admission ? { decisionAdmission: admission } : {},
				signal: decisionAbortController.signal
			}), complete ? this.remainingDuration(run) : remaining);
			if (decisionOrDeadline === DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) {
				decisionAbortController.abort();
				return { outcome: this.stop("MAX_DURATION", "Duration budget exhausted while deciding the next step.") };
			};
			const turn = decisionOrDeadline;
			if (complete) {
				const state = run.state.toolResultContext;
				const expected = state.decisionAdmissions.filter((value) => value.stepNumber === stepNumber && value.status === "SETTLED").map((value) => value.admissionId);
				if (turn.usage !== undefined || !Array.isArray(turn.decisionAdmissionIds) || (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.completeSnapshot)(turn.decisionAdmissionIds) !== (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.completeSnapshot)(expected) || state.pendingDecisionAdmission || state.decisionAdmissions.some((value) => value.status === "UNKNOWN")) {
					throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Decision receipts or usage ownership are inconsistent.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
				};
				return {
					decision: turn.decision,
					decisionAdmissionIds: expected,
					modelDecision: expected.some((value) => !priorIds.has(value))
				};
			};
			const usage = turn.usage ?? __vite_ssr_import_1__.EMPTY_MODEL_USAGE;
			this.accountUsage(run, usage);
			const usageStop = this.checkAfterUsage(run);
			if (usageStop) return { outcome: this.stop(usageStop.reason, usageStop.response) };
			return { decision: turn.decision };
		} catch (error) {
			failed = true;
			throw error;
		} finally {
			decisionAbortController.abort();
			parentSignal?.removeEventListener("abort", abort);
			try {
				await admission?.close(failed ? "decision_failed" : "decision_closed");
			} catch (error) {
				if (!failed) throw error;
			}
		}
	}
	/**
	* A non-idempotent tool must never be invoked twice for the same decision;
	* the safe threshold is one repeat (stop before the second effect).
	*/
	effectiveRepeatThreshold(run, decision) {
		if (decision.decisionType === "CALL_TOOL" || decision.decisionType === "REQUEST_APPROVAL") {
			const tool = this.options.tools.resolve(decision.toolId, decision.toolVersion);
			if (tool && tool.idempotent === false && tool.sideEffect !== "NONE") {
				return 1;
			}
		};
		return this.repeatThreshold;
	}
	validateDecision(run, decision) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.validateDecision)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision);
	}
	allowedDecisionTypes(run) {
		const allowed = ["RESPOND", "ASK_USER"];
		if (this.availableTools(run).length > 0) {
			allowed.push("CALL_TOOL", "REQUEST_APPROVAL");
		};
		if (this.options.knowledge && this.remaining(run, "knowledge") > 0) {
			allowed.push("SEARCH_KNOWLEDGE");
		};
		if (this.remaining(run, "verification") > 0) {
			allowed.push("VERIFY");
		};
		if (this.remaining(run, "replan") > 0) {
			allowed.push("REPLAN");
		};
		allowed.push("HANDOFF", "STOP");
		return allowed;
	}
	remaining(run, kind) {
		const budget = run.input.budget;
		if (kind === "knowledge") {
			return Math.max(0, (budget.maxKnowledgeCalls ?? budget.maxSteps) - run.usage.knowledgeCalls);
		};
		if (kind === "verification") {
			return Math.max(0, (budget.maxVerificationCalls ?? budget.maxSteps) - run.usage.verificationCalls);
		};
		return Math.max(0, (budget.maxReplans ?? budget.maxSteps) - run.usage.replans);
	}
	availableTools(run) {
		return this.options.tools.list().filter((tool) => (0,__vite_ssr_import_9__.agentExposesTool)(run.input.agent.tools, tool.id)).map(describeTool);
	}
	async dispatch(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		switch (decision.decisionType) {
			case "CALL_TOOL": return this.dispatchTool(run, decision, stepNumber, false);
			case "REQUEST_APPROVAL": return this.dispatchTool(run, decision, stepNumber, true);
			case "SEARCH_KNOWLEDGE": return this.dispatchKnowledge(run, decision, stepNumber);
			case "VERIFY": return this.dispatchVerify(run, decision, stepNumber);
			case "REPLAN": return this.dispatchReplan(run, decision, stepNumber);
			case "RESPOND": return this.dispatchRespond(run, decision, stepNumber);
			case "ASK_USER": return {
				kind: "pause",
				pausedKind: "NEEDS_USER_INPUT",
				decision
			};
			case "HANDOFF":
				await this.recordStep(run, {
					stepNumber,
					stepType: "HANDOFF",
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					sideEffecting: false,
					reasonCode: decision.reasonCode
				});
				return this.stop("HUMAN_TAKEOVER", "Execution handed off to a human operator.");
			case "STOP":
				await this.recordStep(run, {
					stepNumber,
					stepType: "STOP",
					status: "SUCCEEDED",
					sideEffecting: false,
					reasonCode: decision.reasonCode
				});
				return { kind: "continue" };
		}
	}
	async dispatchTool(run, decision, stepNumber, forceApproval) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.dispatchTool)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision, stepNumber, forceApproval);
	}
	async dispatchKnowledge(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.dispatchKnowledge)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision, stepNumber);
	}
	async dispatchVerify(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		const verificationLimit = run.input.budget.maxVerificationCalls ?? run.input.budget.maxSteps;
		/* v8 ignore next -- defensive: the allowed-decision gate already stops at the bound */
		if (run.usage.verificationCalls + 1 > verificationLimit) {
			return this.stop("MAX_VERIFICATION_CALLS", "Verification budget exhausted.");
		};
		run.usage.verificationCalls += 1;
		await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
		const target = decision.verificationTarget;
		const verification = this.verify(run, target);
		await this.recordObservation(run, this.makeObservation(run, {
			stepId: `step_${run.executionId}_${stepNumber}_verify`,
			stepNumber,
			type: "VERIFICATION",
			source: "SYSTEM",
			trust: "TRUSTED",
			payload: {
				target,
				...verification
			},
			summary: `Verification ${verification.valid ? "passed" : "failed"} for target ${target}.`,
			provenance: { sourceId: "runtime-verifier" }
		}));
		await this.recordStep(run, {
			stepNumber,
			stepType: "VERIFY",
			status: verification.valid ? "SUCCEEDED" : "FAILED",
			sideEffecting: false,
			reasonCode: decision.reasonCode,
			...verification.valid ? {} : { errorCode: "verification_failed" }
		});
		if (!verification.valid) {
			run.skipEvaluationOnce = true;
			const revisionEvaluation = {
				outcome: "INCOMPLETE",
				reasonCode: "VERIFICATION_FAILED",
				deterministic: true,
				detail: verification.details.join("; ")
			};
			run.state = {
				...run.state,
				lastEvaluation: revisionEvaluation
			};
			run.lastEvaluation = revisionEvaluation;
		};
		return { kind: "continue" };
	}
	verify(run, target) {
		if (target === "tool-result") {
			const succeeded = run.lastToolObservation !== null && run.lastToolObservation.payload?.status === "SUCCEEDED";
			return {
				valid: succeeded,
				details: succeeded ? [] : ["no successful tool result is available"]
			};
		};
		if (target === "evidence-coverage") {
			const valid = run.lastSufficiency === "SUFFICIENT";
			return {
				valid,
				details: valid ? [] : [`evidence sufficiency is ${run.lastSufficiency ?? "unknown"}`]
			};
		};
		if (target === "response-claims") {
			const validation = this.validateClaims(run, run.responseText ?? "");
			return {
				valid: validation.valid,
				details: validation.unsupportedClaims
			};
		};
		return {
			valid: false,
			details: [`unsupported verification target ${target}`]
		};
	}
	validateClaims(run, responseText) {
		const extractor = this.options.claimExtractor;
		if (!extractor || !responseText.trim()) {
			return {
				valid: true,
				unsupportedClaims: []
			};
		};
		return defaultClaimValidation(extractor(responseText), run.observations);
	}
	async dispatchReplan(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		const replanLimit = run.input.budget.maxReplans ?? run.input.budget.maxSteps;
		/* v8 ignore next -- defensive: the allowed-decision gate already stops at the bound */
		if (run.usage.replans + 1 > replanLimit) {
			return this.stop("MAX_REPLANS", "Replan budget exhausted.");
		};
		run.usage.replans += 1;
		await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
		await this.recordObservation(run, this.makeObservation(run, {
			stepId: `step_${run.executionId}_${stepNumber}_replan`,
			stepNumber,
			type: "SYSTEM_EVENT",
			source: "SYSTEM",
			trust: "TRUSTED",
			payload: {
				event: "replan",
				reasonCode: decision.reasonCode
			},
			summary: `Strategy changed: ${decision.reasonCode}.`,
			provenance: { sourceId: "runtime-replan" }
		}));
		await this.recordStep(run, {
			stepNumber,
			stepType: "MODEL",
			status: "SUCCEEDED",
			sideEffecting: false,
			reasonCode: decision.reasonCode
		});
		await this.safeAudit(run, "runtime.replanned", { result: decision.reasonCode });
		return { kind: "continue" };
	}
	async dispatchRespond(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.dispatchRespond)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision, stepNumber);
	}
	async composeResponse(run, decision) {
		if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
			const assembled = await this.buildStepContext(run, run.state.stepNumber);
			if ("outcome" in assembled) {
				return {
					stopReason: assembled.outcome.stopReason,
					response: assembled.outcome.response
				};
			};
			return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.composeResponse)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision, assembled.context);
		};
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.composeResponse)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision);
	}
	evaluatorFor(run) {
		if (this.completionEvaluatorOverride) {
			return this.completionEvaluatorOverride;
		};
		const strategy = run.input.agent.completionStrategy ?? "DETERMINISTIC";
		const cached = this.completionEvaluators.get(strategy);
		if (cached) return cached;
		const evaluator = new __vite_ssr_import_6__.DeterministicCompletionEvaluator({ strategy });
		this.completionEvaluators.set(strategy, evaluator);
		return evaluator;
	}
	async evaluate(run, decision) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.evaluate)(this.dispatchContext, run, decision);
	}
	async pause(run, stepNumber, outcome) {
		return (0,__vite_ssr_import_15__.pause)(this.dispatchContext, run, stepNumber, outcome);
	}
	/**
	* Post-usage gate for orchestrator-reported usage (PDSH-004). The
	* beginModelRequest pre-model slot already gates the kernel's model call;
	* this catches reported overages so the loop still stops honestly.
	*/
	checkAfterUsage(run) {
		if (run.usage.modelCalls > run.input.budget.maxModelCalls) {
			return {
				reason: "MAX_MODEL_CALLS",
				response: "Model-call budget exhausted."
			};
		};
		if (run.usage.inputTokens + run.usage.outputTokens > run.input.budget.maxTokens) {
			return {
				reason: "MAX_TOKENS",
				response: "Token budget exhausted."
			};
		};
		if (run.usage.costUsd > run.input.budget.maxCostUsd) {
			return {
				reason: "MAX_COST",
				response: "Cost budget exhausted."
			};
		};
		return null;
	}
	accountUsage(run, usage) {
		run.usage.modelCalls += usage.modelCalls;
		run.usage.inputTokens += usage.inputTokens;
		run.usage.outputTokens += usage.outputTokens;
		run.usage.costUsd += usage.costUsd;
	}
	effectiveDuration(run) {
		return run.usage.activeDurationMs + (Date.now() - run.startedAtMs);
	}
	remainingDuration(run) {
		return run.input.budget.maxDurationMs - this.effectiveDuration(run);
	}
	makeObservation(run, input) {
		let payload = input.payload;
		if (this.options.toolResultContext && input.type === "TOOL_RESULT") {
			const value = payload;
			const tool = this.options.tools.resolve(input.provenance.sourceId, input.provenance.sourceVersion);
			if (!tool) throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Tool observation has no native registry binding.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
			if (value.schemaVersion !== 1) {
				payload = value.status === "SUCCEEDED" ? (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.completeToolPayload)(value.output, tool.sideEffect) : {
					schemaVersion: 1,
					status: value.status === "REJECTED" ? "REJECTED" : "FAILED",
					sideEffect: tool.sideEffect,
					completion: "NOT_APPLICABLE",
					resultAvailability: "UNAVAILABLE",
					error: typeof value.error === "string" ? value.error.slice(0, 512) : "tool_failed"
				};
			}
		};
		const observation = {
			observationId: `obs_${(0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.randomUUID)()}`,
			executionId: run.executionId,
			stepId: input.stepId,
			stepNumber: input.stepNumber,
			type: input.type,
			source: input.source,
			trust: input.trust,
			payload: this.options.toolResultContext && input.type === "TOOL_RESULT" ? payload : boundedPayload(payload, this.maxObservationPayloadChars),
			summary: input.summary.slice(0, 500),
			provenance: input.provenance,
			timestamp: this.clock().toISOString()
		};
		if (this.options.toolResultContext && input.type === "TOOL_RESULT") (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.assertCompleteToolObservation)(observation);
		return observation;
	}
	async recordObservation(run, observation) {
		run.observations = this.options.toolResultContext ? (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.retainCompleteObservations)([...run.observations, observation]) : [...run.observations, observation].slice(-__vite_ssr_import_1__.MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS);
		run.state = {
			...run.state,
			observations: run.observations
		};
		await this.safeAudit(run, "observation.recorded", { result: `${observation.source}:${observation.type}` });
	}
	async recordStep(run, input) {
		const stepId = `step_${run.executionId}_${input.stepNumber}_${input.stepType.toLowerCase()}`;
		const terminal = input.status === "SUCCEEDED" || input.status === "FAILED";
		const decisionType = input.decisionType ?? run.lastDecision?.decisionType ?? undefined;
		await this.options.stepStore.recordStep({
			stepId,
			executionId: run.executionId,
			tenantId: run.input.tenantId,
			stepNumber: input.stepNumber,
			stepType: input.stepType,
			status: input.status,
			attempt: 1,
			sideEffecting: input.sideEffecting,
			startedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
			...terminal ? { completedAt: this.clock().toISOString() } : {},
			...decisionType ? { decisionType } : {},
			...input.reasonCode ? { reasonCode: input.reasonCode } : {},
			observationRefs: input.observationRefs ?? [],
			...input.errorCode ? { errorCode: input.errorCode } : {}
		});
		if ((terminal || input.status === "WAITING") && !run.countedSteps.has(input.stepNumber)) {
			run.countedSteps.add(input.stepNumber);
			run.usage.steps += 1;
		};
		await this.safeAudit(run, input.status === "RUNNING" ? "step.started" : "step.completed", {
			result: `${input.stepType}:${input.status}`,
			tool: null
		});
	}
	checkpointFor(run, state = run.state, usage = run.usage) {
		return {
			executionId: run.executionId,
			tenantId: run.input.tenantId,
			checkpointVersion: this.options.toolResultContext ? 2 : 1,
			runtimeProfile: "iterative",
			runtimeVersion: __vite_ssr_import_1__.RUNTIME_V2_VERSION,
			orchestratorVersion: this.orchestratorVersion,
			stepNumber: state.stepNumber,
			state: {
				...state,
				observations: this.options.toolResultContext ? (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.retainCompleteObservations)(run.observations) : run.observations.slice(-__vite_ssr_import_1__.MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS)
			},
			budgetUsage: { ...usage }
		};
	}
	preflightDecisionReceipt(run, state, usage) {
		try {
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_8__.checkpointDigest)(this.checkpointFor(run, {
				...run.state,
				toolResultContext: state
			}, usage));
		} catch (error) {
			if (error instanceof __vite_ssr_import_8__.CheckpointError && error.message === "Checkpoint byte limit" || error instanceof __vite_ssr_import_2__.CompleteJsonError && error.code === "RESULT_TOO_LARGE") {
				throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", "No checkpoint space for the decision receipt.");
			};
			throw error;
		}
	}
	async persistCheckpoint(run) {
		const checkpoint = (0,__vite_ssr_import_8__.sealCheckpoint)(this.checkpointFor(run));
		if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
			const result = await this.options.stepStore.compareAndSwapCheckpoint({
				tenantId: run.input.tenantId,
				executionId: run.executionId,
				expected: run.checkpointToken ?? null,
				next: checkpoint
			});
			if (result.status !== "APPLIED" || result.token.checkpointId !== checkpoint.checkpointId || result.token.digest !== checkpoint.digest) {
				run.checkpointConflict = true;
				throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Checkpoint compare-and-swap did not commit this writer.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
			};
			run.checkpointToken = result.token;
		} else {
			await this.options.stepStore.saveCheckpoint(checkpoint);
		}
	}
	preflightCompleteTool(run, decision, stepNumber) {
		if (!this.options.toolResultContext) return;
		const tool = this.options.tools.resolve(decision.toolId ?? "", decision.toolVersion);
		if (!tool) throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("STATE_CONFLICT", "Missing native tool.", "STATE_CONFLICT");
		if (run.observations.filter((value) => value.type === "TOOL_RESULT").length >= __vite_ssr_import_1__.MAX_CHECKPOINT_OBSERVATIONS) {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", "No retention slot remains before tool dispatch.");
		};
		const placeholder = this.makeObservation(run, {
			stepId: `step_${run.executionId}_${stepNumber}_tool`,
			stepNumber,
			type: "TOOL_RESULT",
			source: "TOOL",
			trust: "UNTRUSTED",
			payload: {
				status: "SUCCEEDED",
				output: "x".repeat(32766)
			},
			summary: "x".repeat(500),
			provenance: {
				sourceId: tool.id,
				sourceVersion: tool.version,
				operationKey: this.operationKey(run, stepNumber, tool.id),
				effectRef: this.operationKey(run, stepNumber, tool.id)
			}
		});
		const prospective = {
			executionId: run.executionId,
			tenantId: run.input.tenantId,
			checkpointVersion: 2,
			runtimeProfile: "iterative",
			runtimeVersion: __vite_ssr_import_1__.RUNTIME_V2_VERSION,
			orchestratorVersion: this.orchestratorVersion,
			stepNumber: run.state.stepNumber,
			state: {
				...run.state,
				pendingDecision: decision,
				pendingStepNumber: stepNumber,
				observations: (0,__vite_ssr_import_4__.retainCompleteObservations)([...run.observations, placeholder])
			},
			budgetUsage: {
				...run.usage,
				toolCalls: run.usage.toolCalls + 1
			}
		};
		try {
			// Optional internal fields are absent on the wire. Real saves use the
			// stricter schema-owned checkpoint codec, not this size-only projection.
			(0,__vite_ssr_import_2__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(prospective)), {
				maxBytes: __vite_ssr_import_2__.COMPLETE_CHECKPOINT_MAX_BYTES - 65536,
				maxDepth: 64,
				maxNodes: 1e6
			});
		} catch {
			throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("CONTEXT_OVERFLOW", "Prospective checkpoint cannot reserve full tool result and step overhead.");
		}
	}
	operationKey(run, stepNumber, toolId) {
		return `${run.executionId}:s${stepNumber}:${toolId}`;
	}
	async safeAudit(run, action, extras) {
		try {
			await this.options.audit.append({
				actor: run.input.agent.id,
				agent: run.input.agent.id,
				tenant: run.input.tenantId,
				action,
				policy: null,
				approval: run.state.pendingApprovalId ?? null,
				tool: extras.tool ?? null,
				result: extras.result,
				timestamp: this.clock().toISOString(),
				traceId: run.input.traceId,
				correlationId: run.input.correlationId
			});
		} catch {
			if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
				throw new __vite_ssr_import_2__.ToolResultContextError("ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE", "Native audit could not record the governed step.");
			}
		}
	}
	/**
	* A terminal stop never leaves its pending tool step open (AUD-0600 F02).
	* A WAITING step never reached its effect (approval wait, or parked by an
	* operator pause), so it closes with the stop's own code. A step still
	* RUNNING here may have started its effect before a crash or a failure
	* after dispatch, so it is closed as `unknown_effect` for reconciliation
	* instead of being declared not executed.
	*/
	async closePendingStep(run, stopReason) {
		const stepNumber = run.state.pendingStepNumber;
		if (!stepNumber) return;
		const steps = await this.options.stepStore.listSteps(run.input.tenantId, run.executionId);
		const step = steps.find((candidate) => candidate.stepNumber === stepNumber && candidate.stepType === "TOOL");
		if (!step || step.status !== "WAITING" && step.status !== "RUNNING") {
			return;
		};
		await this.recordStep(run, {
			stepNumber,
			stepType: "TOOL",
			status: "FAILED",
			sideEffecting: step.sideEffecting,
			...step.reasonCode ? { reasonCode: step.reasonCode } : {},
			errorCode: step.status === "RUNNING" ? "unknown_effect" : stopReason === "CANCELLED" ? "cancelled" : stopReason === "MAX_DURATION" ? "deadline" : "not_started"
		});
	}
	async finalize(run, outcome, startedAtMs) {
		let stopReason = outcome.stopReason;
		run.usage.activeDurationMs += Date.now() - startedAtMs;
		if (!outcome.preserveCheckpoint && TERMINAL_STOPS.has(stopReason)) {
			try {
				await this.closePendingStep(run, stopReason);
			} catch {
				// The open step could not be closed: the terminal checkpoint must not
				// claim a clean stop while the step store disagrees.
				stopReason = "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE";
			}
		};
		run.state = {
			...run.state,
			stopReason
		};
		let checkpointProven = true;
		if (outcome.preserveCheckpoint) {} else {
			try {
				await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
			} catch {
				checkpointProven = false;
			}
		};
		const claimedReason = checkpointProven ? stopReason : "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE";
		if (!checkpointProven) {
			run.state = {
				...run.state,
				stopReason: claimedReason
			};
		};
		const result = {
			response: outcome.response,
			stopReason: claimedReason,
			...outcome.kind === "stop" && outcome.approvalId ? { approvalId: outcome.approvalId } : {},
			steps: run.usage.steps,
			modelCalls: run.usage.modelCalls,
			toolCalls: run.usage.toolCalls,
			usage: {
				inputTokens: run.usage.inputTokens,
				outputTokens: run.usage.outputTokens,
				costUsd: run.usage.costUsd
			},
			...run.lastToolObservation ? { toolResult: {
				/* v8 ignore next -- only a successful tool observation is stored */
				status: run.lastToolObservation.payload?.status === "SUCCEEDED" ? "SUCCEEDED" : "REJECTED",
				output: run.lastToolObservation.payload?.output
			} } : {}
		};
		const finalResult = await this.recordAuditOutcome(run, result, claimedReason);
		this.recordTelemetry(run, finalResult, startedAtMs);
		return finalResult;
	}
	async recordAuditOutcome(run, result, stopReason) {
		const action = stopReason === "COMPLETED" ? "runtime.completed" : stopReason === "NEEDS_USER_INPUT" || stopReason === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" ? "runtime.paused" : "runtime.stopped";
		// Audit always gets at least a bounded grace window, so a budget stop
		// (possibly after an effect) is still recorded. If even that fails, the
		// result is degraded like any other unaudited outcome (ENG-008).
		try {
			const deadlineMs = Math.max(this.remainingDuration(run), AUDIT_GRACE_MS);
			const auditOrDeadline = await this.withDeadline(this.options.audit.append({
				actor: run.input.agent.id,
				agent: run.input.agent.id,
				tenant: run.input.tenantId,
				action,
				policy: null,
				approval: result.approvalId ?? null,
				tool: run.lastToolObservation?.provenance.sourceId ?? null,
				result: stopReason,
				timestamp: this.clock().toISOString(),
				traceId: run.input.traceId,
				correlationId: run.input.correlationId
			}), deadlineMs);
			if (auditOrDeadline === DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) {
				throw new Error("audit deadline exceeded");
			};
			return result;
		} catch (error) {
			if (this.options.toolResultContext) {
				// A required audit veto cannot leave a healthy writer advertising a
				// successful terminal checkpoint. Keep all acknowledged usage/effects.
				run.state = {
					...run.state,
					stopReason: "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
				};
				try {
					await this.persistCheckpoint(run);
				} catch {}
			};
			return {
				...result,
				response: run.primaryResponseFailure ? `${result.response} Secondary audit recording failure: ${errorMessage(error)}.` : "Execution could not be completed because audit recording failed.",
				stopReason: "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
			};
		}
	}
	recordTelemetry(run, result, startedAtMs) {
		const telemetry = {
			name: "harness.iterative",
			latencyMs: Date.now() - startedAtMs,
			errors: result.stopReason === "COMPLETED" ? 0 : 1,
			costUsd: result.usage.costUsd,
			inputTokens: result.usage.inputTokens,
			outputTokens: result.usage.outputTokens,
			provider: null,
			toolDurationMs: 0,
			steps: result.steps,
			traceId: run.input.traceId,
			correlationId: run.input.correlationId,
			attributes: {
				outcome: result.stopReason,
				model_calls: result.modelCalls,
				tool_calls: result.toolCalls,
				knowledge_calls: run.usage.knowledgeCalls,
				replans: run.usage.replans,
				verification_calls: run.usage.verificationCalls
			}
		};
		try {
			this.options.telemetry.record(telemetry);
		} catch {}
	}
	async earlyFinish(input, response, stopReason, startedAtMs) {
		void startedAtMs;
		const result = {
			response,
			stopReason,
			steps: 0,
			modelCalls: 0,
			toolCalls: 0,
			usage: {
				inputTokens: 0,
				outputTokens: 0,
				costUsd: 0
			}
		};
		try {
			await this.options.audit.append({
				actor: input.agent.id,
				agent: input.agent.id,
				tenant: input.tenantId,
				action: "runtime.stopped",
				policy: null,
				approval: null,
				tool: null,
				result: stopReason,
				timestamp: this.clock().toISOString(),
				traceId: input.traceId,
				correlationId: input.correlationId
			});
		} catch {
			return {
				...result,
				response: "Execution could not be completed because audit recording failed.",
				stopReason: "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE"
			};
		};
		return result;
	}
	async withDeadline(operation, remainingMs) {
		if (remainingMs <= 0) return DEADLINE_EXCEEDED;
		let timer;
		const deadline = new Promise((resolve) => {
			timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(DEADLINE_EXCEEDED), remainingMs);
		});
		try {
			return await Promise.race([operation, deadline]);
		} finally {
			clearTimeout(timer);
		}
	}
};
function stringifySummary(value, fallback) {
	if (value === undefined || value === null) return fallback;
	if (typeof value === "string") return value.slice(0, 300);
	try {
		return (JSON.stringify(value) ?? fallback).slice(0, 300);
	} catch {
		return fallback;
	}
}
